conclusion.finding: The documented construction case flags a larger, more spatially connected radar response than the two comparison candidates, but all three trigger and every optical comparison is insufficient. This supports review-first candidate triage, not calibrated construction discrimination, vehicle detection, or a false-positive rate.
conclusion.unchanged: Thresholds, masks, AOIs, windows and original frozen labels were not changed to fit outputs. No extra live runs were dispatched.

visual_reviews.method: Codex visual inspection of original before/after/overlay 400 x 400 VV display PNGs and saved diagnostics; independent human adjudication remains pending.
visual_reviews.observation: VV target has expanded bright returns in the upper-left/central-left compared with the baseline. The overlay contains larger connected regions in the northwest, centre and southwest plus other patches; the dark lower-right feature persists. This is a signal/appearance change at a documented construction location, not a resolved building, equipment or vehicle classification.
